qualification.details: Consultant (Administration & Establishment): Retired from the post of Under Secretary or equivalent or above in the Central or State Governments or Statutory Organizations or Autonomous or Public Sector Undertakings. Handled matters analogous to the advertised positions for a period of at least 10 years while in Government Service. Consultant (Civil Engineer): Handled matters analogous to the advertised positions for a period of at least 10 years while in Government Service. Consultant (Finance & Economic Services): Handled matters analogous to the advertised positions for a period of at least 10 years while in Government Service. Consultant (Market Promotion & Scheme Implementation): Handled matters analogous to the advertised positions for a period of at least 10 years while in Government Service. Young Professional (Finance & Economic Services): CA or CMA or B.Com with MBA (Finance) or equivalent from a recognized University. 1-year Post-Qualification Experience in Finance, Accounts and Audit. Young Professional (Market Promotion & Scheme Implementation): MBA (Marketing) or equivalent from a recognized University. 1-year Post Qualification Experience in Marketing/ Product Positioning/ Export Promotion/ Foreign Trade/ Supply Chain Management/ Retail Management/ FMCG Sector, preferably, in Jute/Textiles Sector. Young Professional (Technology & Technical): M.Tech or ME in Textile Engineering or Jute Technology or equivalent from a recognized University. 1-year Post-Qualification Experience in Textiles/Jute/Agri-business/Agricultural Research/R&D Projects/Product Development/Technology Upgradation/Transfer.

content_sections.heading: NJB Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NJB Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NJB Job 2026 Employment Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NJB Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 14 vacancies are available - 2 for Consultant (Administration & Establishment), 1 for Consultant (Civil Engineer), 2 for Consultant (Finance & Economic Services), 4 for Consultant (Market Promotion & Scheme Implementation), 2 for Young Professional (Finance & Economic Services), 2 for Young Professional (Market Promotion & Scheme Implementation), and 1 for Young Professional (Technology & Technical).

content_sections.heading: NJB Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Consultant (Administration & Establishment): Retired from the post of Under Secretary or equivalent or above in the Central or State Governments or Statutory Organizations or Autonomous or Public Sector Undertakings. Handled matters analogous to the advertised positions for a period of at least 10 years while in Government Service. Consultant (Civil Engineer): Handled matters analogous to the advertised positions for a period of at least 10 years while in Government Service. Consultant (Finance & Economic Services): Handled matters analogous to the advertised positions for a period of at least 10 years while in Government Service. Consultant (Market Promotion & Scheme Implementation): Handled matters analogous to the advertised positions for a period of at least 10 years while in Government Service. Young Professional (Finance & Economic Services): CA or CMA or B.Com with MBA (Finance) or equivalent from a recognized University. 1-year Post-Qualification Experience in Finance, Accounts and Audit. Young Professional (Market Promotion & Scheme Implementation): MBA (Marketing) or equivalent from a recognized University. 1-year Post Qualification Experience in Marketing/ Product Positioning/ Export Promotion/ Foreign Trade/ Supply Chain Management/ Retail Management/ FMCG Sector, preferably, in Jute/Textiles Sector. Young Professional (Technology & Technical): M.Tech or ME in Textile Engineering or Jute Technology or equivalent from a recognized University. 1-year Post-Qualification Experience in Textiles/Jute/Agri-business/Agricultural Research/R&D Projects/Product Development/Technology Upgradation/Transfer.

content_sections.text: Consultant: Maximum age limit is 63 years. Young Professional: Maximum age limit is 35 years. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: NJB Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Young Professional (Finance & Economic Services): Rs. 70,000 INR per Month Young Professional (Market Promotion & Scheme Implementation): Rs. 70,000 INR per Month Young Professional (Technology & Technical): Rs. 70,000 INR per Month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NJB Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.jute.com. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 18-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NJB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the National Jute Board Recruitment 2026 is 18th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the board before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NJB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 14 vacancies announced for the posts of Consultants and Young Professionals in the National Jute Board Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NJB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the National Jute Board Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for Young Professionals?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Professional posts in NJB Recruitment 2026 is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered to Young Professionals?
faq.answer: Young Professionals will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 70,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for Consultants?
faq.answer: Consultants should be retired from equivalent or higher posts in government or public sector undertakings, with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q7. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Jute Board (NJB).

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for NJB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The job location is Kolkata, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for NJB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The posts of Consultants and Young Professionals are on a contract basis with the National Jute Board.
